description: Xiaomi 18 Fold brings a wide foldable design with dual 120Hz AMOLED displays, Xiaomi’s Xring O3 AI flagship SoC and up to 16GB RAM with 1TB storage. Its camera setup includes a 200-megapixel Leica-backed main sensor, a 50-megapixel periscope telephoto and a 50-megapixel ultrawide camera. The foldable also supports 67W wired and 50W wireless charging, alongside Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6.0, NFC and UWB. It gets IP58 and IP59 ratings and offers fingerprint and face unlock for security.
title: Xiaomi 18 Fold Launched With 7.58-Inch Main Display, 200-Megapixel Leica-Backed Camera: Price, Features

description: WhatsApp is said to be working on a guest call feature. This could let users reach non-WhatsApp users through secure links, enabling simple end-to-end encrypted calling without app installation. This functionality is said to be built on WhatsApp's existing guest chat mechanism. This could allow WhatsApp users to call people who do not use the messaging platform. WhatsApp will reportedly require the host to manually approve every guest's request before they join the call
title: WhatsApp May Launch a Guest Calls Feature, Allowing People Without an Account to Join Calls

description: Rocket has halted deposits, withdrawals, and trading after an attacker manipulated an inactive perpetual market to generate artificial profits. The attacker used a burner wallet to trade against itself at inflated prices before withdrawing around $287,000 (roughly Rs. 2.7 crore) from the Bridge. Rocket said it is working with security firms, exchanges, bridges, stablecoin issuers, and law enforcement to investigate the incident.
title: Rocket Loses $287,000 in Attack Targeting Dormant Perpetual Market

description: The iQOO 16 could debut in September with hardware aimed at the premium flagship segment, according to a tipster. The handset is expected to feature Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 chipset and a Samsung M16 display with a 2K+ resolution and 165Hz refresh rate. Other reported upgrades include a dedicated Q4 gaming chip, large camera sensors and an 8,400mAh battery. Earlier leaks have also pointed to 100W wired and 40W wireless charging support on the upcoming smartphone.
title: iQOO 16 Tipped to Launch in September With Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Chip

description: Ripple has added former RBI Governor Raghuram Rajan to the speaker lineup for Swell 2026 in New York. Rajan is scheduled to attend the invitation-only Institutional Summit on October 27, although Ripple has not yet disclosed his discussion topic or session format. The event will also mark the first time Ripple combines Swell with its XRPL Apex developer conference.
title: Ripple’s Swell 2026 to Feature Former RBI Governor Raghuram Rajan at Institutional Summit

description: Ai+ Nova 2 Power is confirmed to launch in India soon. It will go on sale through Flipkart. It is confirmed to ship with a 7,000mAh Li-Polymer battery with support for 33W fast charging. Ai+ claims that the battery will provide all-day usage. It is teased to be available in 6GB + 128GB and 8GB + 128GB RAM and storage configurations. It will be launched in five colour options.
title: Ai+ Nova 2 Power Confirmed to Launch in India Soon; Teased to Feature 7,000mAh Battery, MediaTek Dimensity 7100 SoC

description: Sony and Guerrilla Games are reportedly working on a new Killzone project. According to a report, a new Killzone game is in the very early stages of production. The project is believed to be a remake or a remaster of an older Killzone title. Guerrilla Games is reportedly working with an external studio on the game.
title: Sony and Guerrilla Games Reportedly Working on a New Killzone Project

description: Oppo appears to be preparing to add a new smartphone to its lineup in India. The company has started teasing an upcoming handset, although its moniker or launch date remains under wraps. The teaser offers a glimpse of the phone's design but does not reveal any specifications. Previous reports suggested that Oppo may launch the F35 Pro in the country soon, and the teased handset could be the purported handset, although details have yet to be confirmed.
title: Oppo Teases New Smartphone Launch in India; Could Be F35 Pro With 10,000mAh Battery

description: Samsung is reportedly planning to raise the prices of the Galaxy A57 and Galaxy A37 in India by up to Rs. 6,000, according to a tipster. The claimed revisions cover three configurations of each smartphone, with the Galaxy A37 12GB + 256GB variant seeing the largest increase. The Galaxy A57 12GB + 256GB model is also said to have become Rs. 5,000 more expensive. Samsung’s website had not reflected the claimed new prices at the time of writing.
title: Samsung Galaxy A57, Galaxy A37 Prices Reportedly Hiked in India by Up to Rs 6,000: Here's What You Need to Know

description: OnePlus 16 is expected to launch in October. While OnePlus has yet to officially confirm this, a tipster has now revealed several key specifications, including its battery capacity, processor, and display refresh rate. It is tipped to come with a 9,000mAh battery and a 200-megapixel primary camera. The display of the phone could feature up to a 185Hz refresh rate.
title: OnePlus 16 Tipped to Feature 9,000mAh Battery and 185Hz Display

description: A tipster has revealed the hardware details of an unannounced iQOO device called the iQOO Pad Ultra. According to the source, the tablet will feature a compact 8.8-inch display, a top-end 2nm Qualcomm processor and even a built-in active cooling fan for sustained performance.
title: iQOO Pad Ultra Tipped to Launch With 8.8-Inch OLED Display, Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoC, and More

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra and Galaxy S27 Pro have allegedly been spotted on China's 3C Certification site. While the listing doesn't reveal anything about the upcoming phones' battery capacity, it offers a glimpse into the possible charging specifications. The Galaxy S27 Pro is speculated to feature a 5,200mAh battery, while the Galaxy S27 Ultra could ship with a 5,800mAh cell.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra, Galaxy S27 Pro Reportedly Bag 3C Certification, Charging Specifications Tipped

description: VodafoneThree is launching Vodafone TV in the UK in October, giving eligible broadband and mobile customers access to live TV, streaming platforms, apps and cloud gaming through an Android TV set-top box. The service supports 4K playback with Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos, while Freely provides more than 70 live channels and thousands of hours of on-demand content. Netflix and HBO Max will be available at launch, with additional services, cloud games and cross-device viewing offered through the platform.
title: Vodafone TV Launched in UK With Live Channels, Streaming, Gaming and More

description: Huawei Mate XT 2 Ultimate Design was launched on Monday as the company’s second tri-fold smartphone, building upon the Mate XT that arrived as the world’s first mass-market tri-fold model last year. The handset sports a 10.2-inch 3K OLED screen when fully unfolded, along with a new inward-folding architecture. It has a triple outer camera setup with a 50-megapixel primary camera, a 48-megapixel ultra-wide-angle lens, and a 48-megapixel periscope telephoto shooter. The Huawei Mate XT 2 packs a 5,600mAh battery with 66W wired charging support.
title: Huawei Mate XT 2 Ultimate Design Launched With Kirin 9050 Pro Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: Bitcoin has slipped below 75.5 lakh after stronger US jobs data lifted expectations of a September Fed rate hike. Despite the pressure, ETF inflows and improving on-chain indicators continue to support the broader market. Analysts expect upcoming US CPI data and the Fed meeting to provide important direction for Bitcoin.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $80,000 as Strong US Jobs Data Revives Fed Rate Hike Bets

description: John Ternus took over as Apple's new CEO on September 1. Now, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, in his latest weekly Power On newsletter, said that Tim Cook will not take part in the iPhone event video. Cook is expected to attend Apple's event screening on September 9 from the VIP section. Cook will get a new office at Apple's campus. The report claims that Cook will receive a base salary of $2 million (roughly Rs. 18 crore) and stock units of $45 million (roughly Rs. 4.25 billion) next year.
title: Tim Cook Will Not Appear in Apple's 'Surprise and Shine' Event Video: Mark Gurman

description: OnePlus N6 Lite will be launched in India at the end of September, according to a tipster. The upcoming phone is said to be the tech firm's most affordable phone in the country yet. The rumoured N6 series smartphone will be launched with 4GB of RAM, the leaker said in a reply under the X post. Other details about the upcoming phone remain under wraps. This comes shortly after a report highlighted that OnePlus is preparing to launch a 4G smartphone in India in September. The handset is also said to arrive as a budget model.
title: OnePlus N6 Lite to Launch in India This Month as the Firm’s Most Affordable Handset, Tipster Claims

description: Motorola’s reported wide foldable could use a different approach to the rear camera layout, with the module positioned horizontally near the centre of the back. Leaked sketches also show three rear cutouts, although their functions remain unclear. The device may feature cameras on both the inner and outer displays, along with a specially shaped frame for easier opening. A new report claims that Motorola could release the handset in the coming months, but the company has not confirmed its name or launch timeline.
title: Motorola Wide Foldable Design Leaks With Horizontal Camera Module, Creaseless Display

description: Oppo has officially revealed details about its upcoming Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max smartphones. This is the first time the company has officially confirmed these smartphones. In a Weibo post, an Oppo executive says the brand will focus on clearer images with greater colour accuracy.
title: Oppo Find X10 Series Camera Details Revealed, Find X10 Pro Max to Get Three 200-Megapixel Sensors

description: The Blood of Dawnwalker has surpassed 1 million copies sold, developer Rebel Wolves has confirmed. The RPG reached the sales milestone in just two days of launch. The Blood of Dawnwalker launched on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series S/X on September 3.
title: The Blood of Dawnwalker Sells 1 Million Copies in Just 2 Days of Launch

description: Tecno Camon Slim 5G has been announced by the tech firm as the 5G version of the recently launched 4G-only model. The Tecno Camon Slim 5G will be offered in Burgundy Red, Gossamer White, Matisse Black, Neo Mondrian, Rebel Pink, and Van Gogh Blue. It will be available for purchase in 8GB + 128GB and 8GB + 256GB RAM and storage configurations.  The handset sports a 6.78-inch 1.5K (1,208 x 2,644 pixels) AMOLED display, delivering up to a 144Hz refresh rate. An octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7300e chipset powers the smartphone.
title: Tecno Camon Slim 5G Announced With 6.59mm Thickness, 6,000mAh Battery: Specifications, Features

description: New leak reveals the design, colour options, price and key specifications of the Samsung Galaxy A18 4G. It is tipped to come with a 6.7-inch full-HD+ AMOLED display with a 90Hz refresh rate. It could run on a MediaTek Helio G99 chipset paired with 4GB of RAM. It is said to carry a 5,000mAh battery. It is likely to be launched in Black, Light Blue and Silver colour options.
title: Samsung Galaxy A18 4G Price, Design and Key Specifications Leaked Ahead of Launch

description: Oppo Find X10 and Oppo Find X10 Pro Max have been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model numbers PMW110 and PMX110, respectively. As per the listing, the purported Oppo Find X10 will be powered by an octa-core MediaTek MT6993 chipset, which is said to be the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 SoC that also powers its predecessor. On the other hand, the purported Oppo Find X10 Pro Max appeared with the MediaTek MT6995 chipset, which could be the unreleased MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro SoC.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max, Find X10 Appear on Geekbench With MediaTek Dimensity 9000 Series Chipsets

description: Nintendo has announced two Direct showcases for thsi week, including The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct, which will bring a new look at The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake. The Legend of Zelda movie is also expected to get a new update. The Zelda Direct will be broadcast on September 8, followed by Nintendo Direct on September 9.
title: The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Direct and Nintendo Direct Announced for This Week

description: Online retailer Flipkart has teased a new Realme smartphone on its portal, hinting at a Harry Potter-themed device. The banner ad clearly shows Realme’s collaboration with the Harry Potter series, with a caption that makes the partnership quite obvious. At the same time, a leaked render of a Realme 16 Pro smartphone with a Harry Potter theme also appeared briefly before being taken down.
title: Flipkart Teases Realme and Harry Potter Collaboration as Themed Realme 16 Pro With New Design Leaks

description: iQOO Z11xa 5G has been launched in India as the second model in the Z11x lineup. The phone joins the iQOO Z11, iQOO Z11x, and IQOO Z11 Lite. The new handset is set to go on sale in India on September 14 via Amazon. The iQOO Z11xa 5G is offered in Prismatic Green and Titan Black colour options. The company is also offering a flat coupon discount of Rs. 1,500 to customers. Buyers can also avail up to six months of no-cost EMI options. The iQOO Z11xa 5G is a dual SIM handset that ships with Vivo’s Origin 6, which is based on Android 16. The tech firm promises two years of OS upgrades and four years of security updates for the smartphone.
title: iQOO Z11xa 5G Launched in India With Dimensity 7400 Turbo Chipset, 7200mAh Battery: Price, Features

description: Apple's new CEO, John Ternus, and the new head of the App Store, Eddy Cue, are planning to bring new changes to the marketplace to “make even more money”, Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman writes in the latest edition of his weekly newsletter 'Power On'. Ternus and Cue are reportedly looking at ways to raise margins and increase the recurring revenue from the App Store. While the report does not highlight the exact changes that could be made, they could be implemented in the coming months or weeks, allowing the company to further increase its profits.
title: Apple Plans to Make New Changes to App Store to Increase Margins and Recurring Revenue: Report

description: The Motorola Edge 70 series in India is confirmed to get another model. The lineup has steadily expanded since the standard Edge 70 arrived in India last year, with the company subsequently introducing several more models across different price segments. The Lenovo-owned brand has confirmed the existence of the Motorola Edge 70 Neo, teasing its arrival in the coming months. The announcement comes shortly after reports and leaked renders offered an early look at the purported handset.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Neo India Launch Confirmed at IFA 2026; Said to Arrive in ‘Coming Months’

description: The iQOO 16 is expected to arrive as the successor to the iQOO 15 later this year, accompanied by a ‘T’ model. While a launch date has yet to be revealed, the purported flagship has already been seen in leaks and benchmark listings, shedding light on its design and some of its specifications. Now, a reliable tipster has shared another update about the purported handset, revealing a more precise battery capacity.
title: iQOO 16 Could Get One of Its Biggest Battery Upgrades Yet, Tipped to Get 8,400mAh Cell

description: Vivo recently announced the launch date of Android 17-based OriginOS 7 in China, and it is expected to be followed by the introduction of the Vivo X500 series. The lineup, although not officially confirmed, may comprise three models — Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Pro Max. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the Chinese variant of the purported Vivo X500 Pro Max has surfaced on a benchmarking site, revealing performance scores significantly higher than those of its global counterpart.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max With Dimensity 9600 Pro Chip Crosses 4,000 Single-Core Score on Geekbench

description: Sony’s WH-1000XM4C has been detailed through leaked renders that show its design, colour options and expected specifications. The headphones are likely to retain the 40mm drivers, 4Hz to 40kHz frequency response and ANC from the original model, while upgrading wireless connectivity to Bluetooth 6.0. NFC pairing may be removed, and battery life could be shorter. The model is reportedly priced at EUR 249 (roughly Rs. 27,300) in the Eurozone and GBP 219 (roughly Rs. 27,900) in the UK.
title: Sony WH-1000XM4C Design, Price, Specifications Leaked Ahead of Expected Launch

description: Reliance Jio is celebrating its 10th anniversary by offering added benefits to customers with its Rs. 3,599 recharge plan. The TSP is now offering its Rs. 3,599 annual recharge plan with an additional 120GB of 5G data via 10GB monthly boosters each month till the plan is valid. The pack has a validity of 365 days. Hence, subscribers will be able to redeem the booster 12 times. The Jio Special Offer benefits for the Rs. 3,599 prepaid subscribers also include JioHotstar’s Mobile+ Hollywood subscription, along with 50GB of free cloud storage.
title: Reliance Jio 10th Anniversary Offer Adds 120GB Bonus Data and More to Rs. 3,599 Annual Plan: Benefits
